new_results.statement: For independent X,Y,Z with densities at most one and invertible zero-diagonal physical 3x3 block B, every affine perturbation of the corresponding quadratic has density sup at most 6|det B|^{-1/3}.

For exact rank-three A=U Lambda U^T, after two sequential Gram-Schmidt localization rows with squared leverages c,d, the sum of absolute principal-triple determinants through those rows equals |det Lambda| c d; absence of a good triple forces the remaining spectral coordinate to be quantitatively diffuse.
Applying the newest named partner, the synthesis debt is confined to off-diagonal stable rank <32; fewer than 32/tau^2 singular directions can exceed tau times the off-diagonal operator norm.
